name: Oddly
description: Big thoughts, small wonders. A cozy custom Copilot Studio chat canvas with Oddly, an original lavender monster, native managed-app agent conversations, saved thoughts, and a no-sign-in sample mode.

prerequisites: Sample mode works without an agent and uses clearly labeled, scripted local responses.

Live chat requires a published standard-harness Copilot Studio agent using Authenticate with Microsoft and a user with access to that agent. The currently generated connector does not support GitHub Copilot harness agents.

Bind the native Microsoft Copilot Studio connector in action mode, with ExecuteCopilotAsyncV2 permitted by tenant policy. Use the authenticated Local Play or hosted player and complete platform connection consent.
Provide your own environment ID and agent schema name in the in-app agent dialog. No custom Entra registration, redirect URI, access token, or client secret is needed.
Live answers arrive as complete text turns. Streaming, tool activity, interactive cards, uploads, and suggested actions are not supported.

connectors.instructions: Select your own Microsoft Copilot Studio connection in the native CLI. The app expects the generated MicrosoftCopilotStudioService with ExecuteCopilotAsyncV2. Open the authenticated player, complete connection consent, then enter your standard-harness agent's environment ID and schema name.
